name: Zhertva: Hra v zdohadky
source:
Not every acquaintance on the Internet ends successfully.

Sometimes you wake up in the morning next to a charming mistress. And sometimes...at an abandoned meat processing plant, tied to a chair.

This is not how the main character planned his first date with a mysterious stranger. A hefty cleaver in her hand and a cheeky smile make it clear that the meeting did not go exactly as planned. Now the hero will have to find out who this mysterious girl is, and what happened.

[Translated from [url=https://80lahd.itch.io/victim-the-guessing-game]itch.io[/url]]
